author: John Baker
title: Ex-CIA Officer Criticizes New Obama Allegations - NewsBreak
text: Former CIA Officer Susan Miller has criticized Director of National Intelligence (DNI) Tulsi Gabbard for her claims regarding Russia’s interference in the 2016 presidential election. Miller argued that Gabbard has misrepresented facts by alleging a “treasonous conspiracy” involving former President Barack Obama, thereby undermining the credibility of her intelligence team. Despite reported objections from officials, Gabbard has continued to push for criminal charges against those involved. Miller said, “My reputation and my team’s reputation is on the line. Tulsi comes out and doesn’t use my name, doesn’t use the names of the people in my team, but basically says this was all wrong and made up, et cetera.” Miller maintained that her team relied on credible intelligence while examining Russian government actions. Gabbard noted that officials claimed Russian President Vladimir Putin had intervened to benefit Trump, allegedly manipulating intelligence to support their narrative. Miller stated, “I told them: ‘Nobody did. If anybody had told us to come to certain conclusions, all of us would have quit. There’s no way, all none of us ever had a reputation for falsifying anything, before anything or after.’” Miller said, “It is not a hoax. This was based on real intelligence. It’s reporting we were getting from verified agents and from other verified streams of intelligence.” Miller stated that several members of her former team are now seeking legal counsel in response to Gabbard’s allegations. She recalled undergoing thorough questioning in a prior inquiry regarding her role in the intelligence assessment. Former DNI James Clapper and former CIA Director John Brennan rejected Gabbard’s claims as “patently false.” Miller criticized Gabbard’s grasp of intelligence processes. Miller stated, “Putin and his BFFs in the Kremlin are toasting vodka shots as we speak at the turmoil this is creating.” John Baker covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
